modalities.evidence: de-identified subjects with interictal iEEG recordings

output.population: De-identified epilepsy patients with interictal intracranial EEG recordings from multiple centers
output.summary: Multicenter interictal intracranial EEG recordings from epilepsy patients, some annotated by sleep or awake state, with derivatives for source-sink and high-frequency-oscillation analyses; some subjects were treated with RNS rather than resection.
